about: Verse of the day. Day 1 is 'start' (viewer's local date); day N shows the Nth verse of 'text' in order. 'days' holds the hook, word of the day and reel for a verse id; anything missing is simply not shown.
title: Meghadūta

1.1.hook: A lover in exile. A cloud as his messenger.

word.en: separation from the one you love
word.note: Inside the compound kāntā-viraha-guruṇā, “heavy with separation from his beloved”. The whole poem grows from it.
